verdict.rationale: A tax agency's online services platform could plausibly offer programmatic API access, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no API or credential-issuance capability, and all OpenAPI probes returned 404. The only related item is adding employees as account users with different access levels, which is human account delegation, not scoped API credentials for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
